ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete clusters and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black background across both lobes; distinct high-intensity white focal 'O' ring on the upper far-left tip; dense cluster of horizontal and diagonal white streaks in the lower-right lobe quadrant; scattered thin white linear markers across the central fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 3 and 18 pixels; significant macro-notches visible on the left lobe trailing edge at roughly the 40% and 70% positions from the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex mathematical curve sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: One prominent high-contrast white circular rosette (ring-shaped) on the far-left distal tip; multiple white micro-focal spots (1-3 pixels) clustered on the far-right distal edge tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions; highly concentrated parallel diagonal rake marks (consistent with 3-5 individual tooth channels) on the lower-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive white 'O' shaped scar on the left lobe tip and heavy parallel linear scarring on the lower right lobe surface; multiple irregular notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical edge loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'O' shaped circular pigmentation mark on the left tip serves as a high-confidence diagnostic identifier.
